consequence.statement: Users who relied on policy exceptions being enabled in all namespaces are affected by the new default exception settings.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, check whether any PolicyExceptions are in namespaces other than the ones exceptions are now enabled for. If they are, explicitly configure the chart's exception settings.

assertion.statement: In Kyverno 1.13.0, the Helm chart no longer enables policy exceptions for all namespaces by default (CVE-2024-48921), which affects users who relied on exceptions working in every namespace.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence refers to 'Helm chart values' for exception settings but never names the values key, and no artifact context gives its exact path.; change: The text says prior chart values enabled exceptions for all namespaces by default, which points to a changed default, but it does not state the old or new literal values.; applicability: The values key is not named, so no values-key predicate (unset or set) can be written.
